name: Markdown Preview
description: Rendered Markdown preview in a side panel: GFM tables, task lists, quotes, syntax-highlighted code blocks, collapsible headings and click-to-source jumps.
author: yyn0210

commands.label: Markdown: Preview
commands.description: Open or refresh the rendered Markdown preview

commands.label: Markdown: Toggle Heading Fold
commands.description: Collapse or expand the section under a heading (from the preview panel)

commands.label: Markdown: Go to Source Line
commands.description: Move the editor cursor to a preview paragraph's source line

settings.label: Show link targets
settings.description: Append the destination URL after link text.

settings.label: Show front matter
settings.description: Render YAML front matter instead of hiding it.
